'''Kazianna Alvamma''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. She became affiliated with the [[White Maw]] pirates on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] and was [[Death/Legends|killed]] around [[3642 BBY]].

==Behind the scenes==
Kazianna Alvamma appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a Champion boss on the planet [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. She is not directly involved in any quests, however she can be killed for loot and as part of the achievement. This article assumes 100% game completion, which means she was killed.
